title: PROPOSED CriterionCategoryAggregate illustrative mock-row design
description: Transcribed from docs/product-truth/mock-data/leafcutter/criterion-categories.mock.json entities.CriterionCategoryAggregate.fields. ADR-065 leaves the aggregate model open; these rows are derived, rebuildable Neo4j statistics that are never written into Git. All listed fields are present in every complete mock row; source is fixture provenance. No Neo4j writer or reader exists for these rows, and the count-sum invariants are stated in the dataset, not here.

id.description: string — fixture handle: <category_id>@<context> (the store keys rows by repository_id, kind, category_id and context)

repository_id.description: string — first part of the key, as on the category

kind.description: enum: criterion_category — the kind of the record the aggregate is keyed on

category_id.description: string — the published CriterionCategory.id the statistics are keyed on

context.description: object { capability, task_type: null in V0, decision_type, components, repository_wide, repository_id, policy_version } — ADR-057 section 7 context; no global rate is ever kept

decision_count.description: integer — published decisions in this context whose criteria are members of the category

pending_count.description: integer — of those, final_outcome.status == pending (no outcome observed yet)

rebuilt_at.description: string — ISO-8601 UTC time of the full rebuild that produced the row

rebuilt_after.description: string — the added item that triggered that rebuild

source.description: string — where this sample row comes from (fixture provenance, not a stored statistic)
